name: Harmine
summary: Harmine, also known as banisterine or telepathine, as well as 7-methoxyharman or 7-methoxy-1-methyl-β-carboline, is a β-carboline and a harmala alkaloid which has hallucinogenic effects and monoamine oxidase inhibitor (MAOI) activity. It occurs in a number of different plants, most notably Peganum harmala and Banisteriopsis caapi.

warnings.text: A 19-year-old died of multiple organ failure in January 2023 after taking 24 ephedrine asthma tablets, then drinking a home brew of Syrian rue (harmala) and acacia bark boiled for over an hour and a half. Harmala alkaloids are MAOIs: with ephedrine or any other stimulant they can push blood pressure high enough to cause bleeding in the brain and heart failure. Acacia bark can hold 5-MeO-DMT, which is dangerous with an MAOI, and bark bought online may carry pesticides. Have a sober sitter, and put knives and sharp things away first.

pharmacology.text: Harmine, also known as banisterine or telepathine, as well as 7-methoxyharman or 7-methoxy-1-methyl-β-carboline, is a β-carboline and a harmala alkaloid which has hallucinogenic effects and monoamine oxidase inhibitor (MAOI) activity. Harmine reversibly inhibits monoamine oxidase A (MAO-A), an enzyme which breaks down monoamines, making it a reversible inhibitor of monoamine oxidase A (RIMA).
pharmacology.kind: Hallucinogen; Oneirogen; Reversible inhibitor of monoamine oxidase A

uses.text: It is essential for enabling the oral activity of DMT in ayahuasca and is also used as a fluorescent pH indicator and in PET imaging to study MAO-A-related brain disorders.
uses.routes: Oral, sublingual, subcutaneous injection, intramuscular injection, intravenous injection

summaryZh: 哈爾明（英語：Harmine，也譯為駱駝蓬鹼）是一種β-咔啉類生物鹼，化學式C13H12N2O。它存在於很多植物中，如駱駝蓬和卡披木。它可以可逆地抑制單胺氧化酶A，但不抑制MAO-B。
